caption: Mole Antonelliana, Turin
composition: Floodlit landmark spire over Turin streets at night · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands at street level looking up as the floodlit Mole rises from the center of the frame, its ribbed dome tapering into the needle spire against a cloudy night sky. Lit apartment blocks line the left and the right foreground, their windows warm against the dark stone, and street lamps bead the avenue below. At 05:06 the monument is the brightest thing in Turin, glowing pale gold above the sleeping streets.
